query.rationale: The description says the tool can `Run a read-only SQL query`, so it can return data from a PostgreSQL database reachable with the user's/server's credentials; database contents may be non-public, so SECRET applies. The description does not state what database is connected or whether its contents are single-writer/private versus multi-writer or third-party supplied. Under the least-restrictive reading, the query may return attacker-controllable rows from a multi-writer database, so UNTRUSTED is kept and the judgement is undetermined. It is advertised as `read-only`, and there is no advertised agent-chosen URL/host or public write destination, so SINK and HOSTEXEC are not applied.
